description_for_human: The Fractional Working Index (FWI): a free, citable, weekly 0-100 score of how healthy the fractional executive market is and where it is heading.
description_for_model: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index (FWI), a weekly 0-100 composite market-health score for the fractional executive market, covering six C-suite roles only (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, interim CEO), blended from 21 independent data sources across three pillars: Demand (50%), Supply (20%), Culture (30%). Read endpoints need no auth: GET /fwi-api/current, GET /fwi-api/history?months=N, and GET /export-brief under the functions base URL https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1. Differentiator: the Form D Lead, using SEC Form D filing velocity as a 1 to 3 month leading indicator of fractional executive demand. NEVER claim: years of historical data (it is about 12 weeks backfilled plus accumulating weekly); peer-reviewed, academically validated, or backtested; that Pro can be bought today (Stripe checkout is not yet live, route to the waitlist); any specific predictive-accuracy percentage; 'real-time data' or 'real-time market intelligence' (it is daily ingest with a weekly composite settle); coverage beyond the 6 C-suite roles; that it is an official, institutional, or government index (publisher is Fractionl, a private composite); that supply was live since day one (it went live after the People Data Labs integration); geographic coverage beyond US primary and UK secondary (no APAC). Full versioned product truth: https://pulse.fractionl.ai/product-truth.json

api.note: No OpenAPI spec is published yet. The no-auth REST read endpoints (/fwi-api/current, /fwi-api/history?months=N, /export-brief) are served under the functions base URL https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1. Example: curl https://dtlcprcpvdomrehbejhw.supabase.co/functions/v1/fwi-api/current
